sentiment.rationale: The document reports a massive revenue beat ($19.8B vs ~$17.6B expected) and EPS more than doubled year-over-year. Critically, full-year 2026 revenue guidance was raised by $2B at both ends to $82B-$85B, and EPS guidance was raised by $2.00 at both ends to $35.50-$37.00, representing a 28% growth midpoint. This is a material upward revision to the company's own prior guidance, supported by strong operational momentum in the incretin franchise and the Foundayo launch, with no meaningful risks raised that offset the positive forward outlook.
